title: Weeknight vegetable curry
main: The whole thing comes together in one pot with very little washing up. It started as a way to use up leftovers and became a family favorite.
This is the recipe I make when friends come over on short notice.
salt and black pepper to taste
Heat the oil in a heavy pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook for eight minutes until soft.
Stir in the garlic and spices and cook for one more minute.
Pour in the tomatoes and stock, then bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and cook for twenty minutes, stirring now and then.
